children: announced on Tuesday the production release of Inverted Metamorphic (IMM) Apex, the new version of its next-generation solar cell designed for space applications.

The company said the solar cell offers solar conversion efficiency of 31.5%, weighs 40% less, and does not require germanium substrates, a mineral that has been used for conventional, multi-junction solar cells produced for the last three decades.
“IMM Apex delivers exceptional performance while addressing real-world challenges like rising material costs and supply chain constraints,”

Brad Clevenger, President of Rocket Lab USA. “With IMM Apex, customers gain access to a high-efficiency, lightweight, germanium-free product that combines proven reliability with faster production times. IMM Apex is designed to more cost-effectively power the most ambitious missions without compromising performance.”
At the time of publication, RKLB shares were up 5% premarket.

title: Rocket Lab unveils lighter, germanium-free solar cell to ease supply constraints
